title: Painting While Facing the Light
content: How can you capture light in a painting while facingtowardthe light? I've got a new video that you can watch hereor on YouTube.››The technique uses watercolor, gouache, and pastel over a casein priming to capture the feeling of objects against a bright sky. I also discuss whether it ‘breaks the rules’ to combine gouache, watercolor and other mixed media.----RELATED BLOG POSTSShould Watercolors Be Purely Transparent?Contre Jour LightingLight Spill
